chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20, short black curly hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and grey sweatpants
chars.UNCLE: a Moroccan man in his 50s, bald with a grey stubble beard, wearing a dark green djellaba over a white undershirt
chars.COUSIN: a Moroccan young woman about 20, wearing a pink hijab, a black denim jacket and a long beige skirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, 3 a.m., a small modest Moroccan bedroom lit only by a dim lamp. UNCLE leans over the bed and shakes NARRATOR awake by the shoulder with an urgent, mischievous look; NARRATOR squints, half asleep, under a striped blanket.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the dark doorway of the bedroom, UNCLE points firmly toward the bathroom, telling NARRATOR to go wash his face; NARRATOR sits on the edge of the bed rubbing his eyes, confused.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan bathroom with zellige tiles at night. NARRATOR splashes cold water on his face over the sink, water drops flying, eyes shocked wide open by the cold.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan salon with low sedari cushions at night, a teapot on a small round table. UNCLE sits cross-legged looking serious and plotting, NARRATOR sits next to him wet-faced and puzzled, both lit by a single lamp.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon at night. UNCLE leans in close and taps the smartphone in NARRATOR's hand, asking a sly question; NARRATOR raises his eyebrows in surprise.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daytime on a busy street in a Moroccan city medina, COUSIN walks outside carrying a shopping bag and answers her ringing phone with a casual, confident smile.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon at night. UNCLE holds up a smartphone showing a call-recording screen with a big red record button and a sound wave (no letters), explaining with a clever grin; NARRATOR stares at the screen, amazed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon at night. UNCLE gestures with both hands like he is laying out a trap step by step, eyebrows raised; NARRATOR listens closely, slowly starting to smile.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan family living room in the afternoon. COUSIN lounges on a sedari cushion chatting on the phone, laughing carelessly and unaware, while in the foreground a phone on a table shows a red recording dot (no letters).
